original_benchmark.notes: AgencyBench V2 comprises 32 multi-stage scenarios (138 ordered subtasks) across Backend (3/15), Code (9/29), Frontend (3/15), Game (10/50), MCP (2/10), and Research (5/19). Pinned upstream commit: ec65324be69e81bd4fe394ef6a86d48b8fa5da56.

harbor_adapter.notes: Stage C deterministic offline-verifiable scope covering 9 scenarios (37 ordered subtasks) across 4 categories and 7 runner families: Backend/scenario1..3 (15/15 subtasks), Code/scenario1,6,7 (7 subtasks), MCP/scenario2 (5 subtasks), and Research/scenario2,3 (10 subtasks).
